topic: Weekly Instagram Reel Plan for Cafes: 4 Reels You Can Film in 1 Hour (Step 1 - Reel #1: Behind-The-Scenes)
title: Behind-the-scenes | 4 Instagram Reels You Can Film in 1 Hour
description: Behind-the-scenes. From our full video: 4 Instagram Reels You Can Film in 1 Hour.

scenes.narration: Reel one is a 15 to 30 second behind-the-scenes. Show how you make a signature item. Example: the bakery-cafe — film pulling a baguette from the oven, sprinkling flour, and slicing. Say: 'Fresh all morning. Come grab this warm loaf.'

Shots: 3 to 5 clips — oven pull, close-up crust, cutting, plated loaf. Keep clips 2 to 4 seconds each. Sound: natural oven ambient and one line of voiceover recorded on your phone. Cost: zero. Tip: film during slow prep, not rush hour.
